title: Crypto in 2026: Oh, This Is the Bad Place
summary: Stephen Diehl's critical analysis of the cryptocurrency ecosystem in 2026, examining the industry's ongoing failures, scams, and systemic problems that continue to plague the space despite years of development.
problem_solved: Provides critical analysis of the cryptocurrency industry's failures and problematic aspects rather than solving a technical problem.
why_valuable: Offers an important dissenting perspective on crypto industry failures, helping readers understand the systemic issues and potential risks in the space.
